title: Bipolar to Unipolar Converter
text: 将双极性信号映射为范围 [0, M – 1] 内的单极性信号，输入 1 路、输出 1 路；按 {Output data type} 指定单极性信号的输出数据类型 Inherit via internal；{M-ary number} 指定符号数、{Polarity} 指定符号的相对顺序，按实例取值。

ports.name: In
ports.summary: 输入信号 scalar | vector | matrix

ports.name: Out
ports.summary: 输出信号 scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: Polarity
params.values: 符号的相对顺序 Positive (default) | Negative

params.name: Output data type
params.values: 单极性信号的输出数据类型 Inherit via internal rule (default) | Same as input | double | int8 | int16 | int32 | uint8 | uint16 | uint32 | boolean
